title: CanCOTS 2025
text:
The first Canadian Conference on Teaching Statistics (CanCOTS 2025) was organized at HEC Montréal from Wednesday June 11th to Thursday June 12th, 2025.
Thanks for your participation! The next edition of CanCOTS will take place in Toronto, June 22-24 2027.
